layers.name: Lớp Giao Diện - Pages & Layouts

layers.name: Lớp Giao Diện - React Components
layers.description: 477 React components được tổ chức theo domain: auth, calendar, contracts, CRM, dashboard, dresses, employees, finance, gallery, inventory, layout, printing, public-gallery, settings, ui, vendors. Bao gồm cả business components và reusable UI components.

metadata.responsibility: UI rendering, user interactions, presentation logic

layers.name: Lớp API - Next.js Route Handlers
layers.description: API routes xử lý HTTP requests: auth callback, contract prefetch, gallery downloads, Drive downloads, calendar sync workers, push notifications, OG image generation, monitoring endpoints. Backend logic chạy trên server.

metadata.responsibility: HTTP request handling, server-side operations, external API integration

layers.name: Lớp Business Logic - Utilities & Helpers
layers.description: 97 files trong lib/ chứa business logic, utilities, helpers: action profiler, amount validation, audit logging, cache invalidation, currency formatting, date utilities, error handling, Google integrations, image processing, payment calculations, validation schemas. metadata.responsibility: Business rules, calculations, utilities, helpers, validation

layers.name: Lớp Data - React Hooks & State Management
layers.description: 22 custom React hooks quản lý state và data fetching: calendar data, contract filters, debounce, finance filters, gallery queries, haptic feedback, infinite scroll, mobile detection, network quality, pull-to-refresh, push subscriptions, realtime subscriptions, scroll direction. Kết nối UI với data layer.

metadata.responsibility: State management, data fetching, side effects, custom hooks

layers.name: Lớp Data - Supabase Clients & Database
layers.description: Supabase clients (browser, server, admin), database types, RPC functions. Kết nối với PostgreSQL database qua Supabase SDK. Xử lý authentication, realtime subscriptions, storage, và database queries.

metadata.responsibility: Database access, authentication, realtime, storage, RPC calls

layers.name: Lớp Types - TypeScript Definitions
layers.description: 27 TypeScript type definition files định nghĩa schemas cho toàn bộ ứng dụng: database types, domain models, API contracts, component props. Đảm bảo type safety và IntelliSense.

metadata.responsibility: Type definitions, interfaces, schemas, type safety

layers.name: Lớp Contexts - React Context Providers
layers.description: 3 React Contexts cung cấp global state: header slots (dynamic header content), pull-to-refresh (mobile gesture), scroll container (scroll position tracking). Shared state không cần props drilling.

layers.name: Lớp Constants - App Constants & Config Data
layers.description: 2 constants files chứa static data: service colors (màu cho từng loại dịch vụ), work statuses (trạng thái công việc). Immutable configuration data.

layers.name: Lớp Infrastructure - Configuration Files
layers.description: Build và runtime configuration: Next.js config (next.config.ts với PWA, Sentry, React Compiler, Image optimization), TypeScript config (tsconfig.json), PostCSS config (Tailwind v4), Jest config (testing), Playwright config (E2E), environment setup (instrumentation.ts cho Sentry server/edge).

layers.name: Lớp Infrastructure - Monitoring & Error Tracking
layers.description: Sentry integration cho error tracking: client config (instrumentation-client.ts với error filtering, sample rate 10%), server config (instrumentation.ts lazy loading), ignoreErrors patterns (ResizeObserver, network errors, hydration warnings, in-app browser scripts). Production monitoring và debugging.

layers.name: Lớp Styles - Design System & CSS
layers.description: Design system với Earth-Tone palette, Tailwind v4, CSS modules: globals.css (design tokens, scrollbar, focus ring), design-system.css (index tập trung), app/styles/ (17 files: animations, badges, base, breadcrumb, buttons, cards, dropdowns, forms, layout, modals, select, tables, tabs, theme, typography, utilities). Stitch P04 Gold Standard architecture.

layers.name: Lớp Assets - Static Files & Media
layers.description: Static assets: PWA icons (icon.png 512x512, apple-icon.png 180x180), public files (manifest.json, robots.txt, service worker scripts). Immutable files served từ CDN.

metadata.responsibility: Static assets, images, PWA icons, public files

layers.name: Lớp Scripts - Build & Migration Scripts
layers.description: 3 Node.js scripts: check-exact-query.js (Supabase query testing), check-fk.js (RPC testing với pagination), fetch_meta.js (web scraping meta tags), fix-imports.js (refactoring imports từ monolithic file), fix.js (repair corrupted files). Development và maintenance utilities.

layers.name: Lớp Tests - Unit & E2E Tests
layers.description: 7 test files với Jest (unit tests cho lib/ và app/actions/) và Playwright (E2E tests trong tests/e2e/). Coverage threshold 70% cho branches, functions, lines, statements. Test setup trong tests/setup.ts.

metadata.responsibility: Unit testing, E2E testing, test utilities

layers.name: Lớp Documentation - Docs & Changelog
layers.description: Documentation files: README.md (Getting Started, Learn More, Deploy instructions), changelog.ts (version history và release notes). Onboarding và reference materials.
